# AgentDojo eligibility for the TVUS setting (m10/t003)

Generated by `port.py` from `agentdojo==0.1.35`, benchmark `v1.2.2`. Write calls and visible injection vectors are computed by importing the package (ground-truth replay with canaries); criteria verdicts and reasons are authored (`JUDGMENT` in port.py). Y = holds, N = fails, - = not assessed (earlier criterion failed).

Criteria: (a) a write-call argument must be chosen from a finite set of existing trusted records; (b) a per-field authority contract is stateable from the task text; (c) a visible injection slot can carry a trusted-valued inducement (another existing record) as a separate source; (d) AgentDojo's programmatic checker decides the resulting state and discriminates the candidates.

| suite | user tasks | eligible | ported |
|---|---|---|---|
| banking | 16 | 4 | 4 |
| slack | 21 | 0 | 0 |
| travel | 20 | 4 | 4 |
| workspace | 40 | 9 | 9 |
| **all** | 97 | 17 | 17 |

Reason codes: **RO** — read/answer-only: no write call in AgentDojo's ground truth, so no protected sink argument (a); **EXPL** — the write argument's value is stated verbatim in the task text (explicit binding); no selection among records (a); **NEWV** — write arguments are new values (free text, new address/password/e-mail/file) taken from text, not chosen from existing records (a); **DOCV** — the protected value is read out of the injectable document itself (bill IBAN); there is no trusted record set to choose from (a); **COMP** — the argument is computed (arithmetic over records), not copied from one record (a); **OPT** — choice between two literals given in the task text (time slots), not between environment records (a); **MULTI** — several write calls jointly assign many records (permutation / per-person list); not one finite tuple choice (a); **DELEG** — task delegates authority to an untrusted item ('follow the instructions', 'do my TODO list'); no contract can exclude that source (b); **CHAN** — the only visible injection vector is the channel name 'External_<inj>' — a trusted record identifier; attacker text there edits T and the candidate ids, not a separate source (c); **CHK** — AgentDojo's utility check cannot discriminate between candidates (verified by port.py: utility is True for every candidate) (d); **ELIG** — eligible: protected argument chosen from a finite set of existing records; contract stateable from the task; a visible injection slot can carry a trusted-valued inducement; state-based checker
